basic_info.description:
Light and bright remodeled Hayes Valley/Mint Hill single family home. Two bedrooms and two baths, on two levels. Remodeled kitchen with stainless appliances; Bosch 5 burner gas stove, dishwasher, and Liebher fridge. One car garage with interior access. Hardwood floors, period details include coved ceiling, built-ins and decorative fireplace in the living room. Sunny deck upstairs with atrium cover and deck downstairs off the family room. Neighborhood is in a sunny micro-climate, close to Duboce Park, Lower Haight restaurants and shops, easy freeway access, trains and bus lines. 99 walk score-walkers Paradise. 

Neighborhood: Close to restaurants, cozy coffeehouses, shopping, grocery stores, parks and public transportation.
